good:
Entrepreneurs kept asking me the same question: would this business survive on this street? I couldn't answer it well. That gap is why I built BestSpot, and it's why the Software Developer opening on your platform team caught my attention. You're solving the same class of problem, at a scale I haven't worked at yet. That's the work I want to keep doing.

The hard part wasn't the model. It was the data. I spent weeks structuring census and OpenStreetMap inputs before I wrote any application code, because I'd learned that unreliable inputs make every later decision worthless. The census tables and the map data disagreed more often than I expected. Two of those early schemas I threw away. The finished platform lets someone compare locations across hundreds of municipalities in seconds. What I took from it was a habit: start from the question the user is actually asking, then work backwards to the schema.

Your team ships features end to end, and that's how I like to work. Own the problem, keep the feedback loop short. At Conestoga I automated a publishing workflow that used to eat hours of manual effort every week, and I've shipped projects that real people rely on. I'd bring that same care to the data layer your platform depends on. I can be reached at girishbhuteja07@gmail.com or (416) 473-8204.
